title: 8 Hours Sightseeing Tour with a Private Chauffeur in Los Angeles
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Free Child Car seat upon request
Tour duration between 6-8hr including driving times from place to place
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a Private Chauffeur Tour of Los Angeles (6–8 hours) fully dedicated to you and your group. Travel in comfort while a professional chauffeur drives you through the city’s most famous attractions and sightseeing locations.

Hotel pickup in Los Angeles, Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, Hollywood, LAX Airport, and Disneyland Resort

Our chauffeurs are professionally dressed, experienced, and knowledgeable about Los Angeles, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience for you and your family. Ride in our luxury fleet of late-model vehicles (no older than 5 years) that are meticulously maintained for safety and comfort.

We operate premium Tesla, Chevrolet, Cadillac, and Volvo vehicles, offering a refined and comfortable ride throughout your private tour.

This is a relaxed private experience with no rush take your time at each stop, enjoy the views, and explore Los Angeles at your own pace.

English and Portuguese-speaking chauffeurs available. Satisfaction guaranteed.
